items.question: How can a mind fixed on that object remain uncut even when the body is being severed?
premises: The body may be undergoing severance at a given time.
A mind fixed on that object is oriented away from bodily injury.
Such fixation prevents the cutting action from affecting that focused mind.
items.inference: A mind gone to that object with focus is not sundered even as the body is being cut.
uncertainties: Extent of fixation required for this immunity remains unspecified
Scope of 'that' object is determined by prior context
items.plain_english: Just as one whose mind is fixed on that object is not cut even while the body is being cut, so too is that mind unaffected.
